categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Changes are confined to src/external_signer.cpp and signer functional tests; it alters internal post-signing validation rather than RPC interfaces or RPC machinery.
categories.rationale: External signer behavior exposed through RPC belongs to the wallet domain rather than RPC.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: src/external_signer.cpp and test/functional/wallet_signer.py govern how the wallet interacts with external hardware signers to sign transactions.
categories.rationale: The PR adds defensive validation to protect user funds if an external signer is buggy or compromised. It checks that 'the signer did not change output count, amounts, or scriptPubKeys, and that all attached signatures and input sighash types commit to all outputs', mitigating risks of modified outputs or unsafe sighashes.
